author: zepenguin0927
body:
Username: zepenguin0927
Reason: Alleged use of fly mod
Reason for unban:

I believe that this was a mistake. My philosophy, like many, is that cheating is not right no matter what I am doing. 

I've been having several problems recently on many servers where I appear to be flying or glitching or whatnot. From what I can tell, it seems that my network has been causing communication errors, leading to what appears to be flying. Prior to this incident, my computer did actually crash while on the server. I will be looking into the cause of that.

I hope this problem can resolved. Thank you for your consideration.
